summary: Novel subcommand registrations in generated group files use literal cmd.AddCommand(...) instead of addNovelCommandIfAbsent(...).
reason: The dogfood novel-features walker and the library's SKILL.md verifier only parse literal AddCommand call sites; helper-based registration makes novel subcommands invisible, producing false command-depth mismatches and flag-attribution errors (e.g. usage --since). The IfAbsent guard is moot for these groups: no generated sibling can collide.
validated_outcome: dogfood novel_features_check 12/12 with zero depth mismatches; SKILL verifier usage/--since error clears.
